create_text_transformer_model: create a TextTransformer model with specified vocab size, embedding dim, num heads, and num layers
init_text_transformer_weights: initialize the TextTransformer model weights using normal distribution with layer-scaled standard deviations
run_text_transformer_forward: run the TextTransformer forward pass on token indices to get contextualized embeddings
build_causal_text_transformer: build a causal TextTransformer with CausalSelfAttentionBlock layers for autoregressive text processing
review_text_transformer_architecture: review the TextTransformer class architecture including token embeddings, positional embeddings, and attention blocks
